senses.gloss: m. (פָּרַשׁ) distinct expression, directness; explanation; commentary.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 52a:4">B. Bath. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>וכולן … יעשה כפֵירוּשָׁן ואם לאו יעשה פ׳ לפירושן</he> and as to all of them (a woman, a slave, or a minor), if they declared before dying, ‘these things belong to—’, he (the trustee) may do according to their explicit declaration, or else (having reasons to distrust their statements) he must make a commentary to their statement (explain the motive they may have had for telling a falsehood).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 52a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>אי … עשה כפֵירוּשָׁה וכ׳</he> if you believe her to be trustworthy, do according to her explicit statement, if not, make a commentary &c. (find out the real state of affairs).

Y. Gitt. V, end, 47ᶜ; Y. Shebi. V, end, 36ᵃ וסתמו לאו כפֵירוּשׁוֹ הוא is the silent lending of a untensil not equal to an explicit statement of the use to be made of it? Snh. 87ᵃ, v. עִיקָּר; a. fr.—בפ׳ (also in Chald. dict.) distinctly, explicitly, directly.
<cite ref="Chullin 95a">Ḥull. 95ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>בפ׳ איתמר</he>, v. <cite ref="K00761"><he>כְּלָלָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:5">Snh. VII, 5</cite> <he>אמור מה ששמעת בפ׳</he> tell plainly now what thou hast heard (the blasphemer say, i.e. repeat without euphemistic disguise, v. <cite ref="K00566"><he>כִּינּוּי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Pesachim 13a:15">Pes. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>בפ׳ אמרת לן</he> you told us plainly.
Sabb. 39ᵇ בפ׳ שמיע לך וכ׳ did you hear that tradition directly or only by implication?; a. fr.—[In commentaries and glosses: פירוש, abbrev. פי׳, this means.]
